tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background for every screen.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Panels, table bodies, inputs and dialogs that sit on `surface`.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Code and evidence blocks, table row hover, disabled controls.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairline borders of panels, tables, inputs. Separation uses borders, not shadows.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body text and headings on `surface`, `surface-raised`, `surface-sunken` and `evidence`.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, line numbers, table headers, help text on `surface` and `surface-raised`.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: Primary actions, links, the selected tab. Never a verdict colour.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `brand` fills.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: 2px solid focus ring on every interactive element; at least 3:1 on every surface.

tokens.name: pass
tokens.usage: Verdict `pass` and judge `AC`: text and icon on `pass-soft`. Blue, not green, so it never pairs red-green with `violation`.

tokens.name: pass-soft
tokens.usage: Background of the `pass` badge.

tokens.name: violation
tokens.usage: Verdict `violation`, judge failures (WA, TLE, MLE, RE, CE), problem-detail borders, destructive text. On `violation-soft`, `surface`, `surface-raised`.

tokens.name: violation-soft
tokens.usage: Background of the `violation` badge and of problem-detail alerts.

tokens.name: unsure
tokens.usage: Verdict `unsure`: text and icon on `unsure-soft`. TA-only; students never see it.

tokens.name: unsure-soft
tokens.usage: Background of the `unsure` badge.

tokens.name: evidence
tokens.usage: Highlight behind an evidence line in a code block; `ink` reads on it in both themes.

families.mono: "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, "Cascadia Mono", Menlo, monospace

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between an icon and its label; badge vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Button vertical padding; gap inside a form field.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Table cell horizontal padding; gap between buttons.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Panel padding; page side gutter on phones.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between page sections; panel padding on desktop.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Top of page to first heading.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Badges, inputs, code-line highlight.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, panels, code blocks, alerts.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Dialogs only.
